title: Monthly Request Volume
scenario: Count how many confirmation requests were made each month. Return the result table as 'month' and 'request_count'.
tableSchema: signups (user_id INT, time_stamp DATETIME), confirmations (user_id INT, time_stamp DATETIME, action VARCHAR)
hint: Format the time_stamp to 'YYYY-MM' and group by it.
correctQuery: SELECT STRFTIME('%Y-%m', time_stamp) AS month, COUNT(*) AS request_count FROM confirmations GROUP BY month;
setupSQL: CREATE TABLE confirmations (user_id INT, time_stamp DATETIME, action VARCHAR); INSERT INTO confirmations VALUES (3, '2021-01-06 03:30:46', 'timeout'), (3, '2021-07-14 14:00:00', 'confirmed'), (7, '2021-06-12 11:57:29', 'confirmed');
